{{Top|leg}}
'''Star Tours Flight 530''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Abregado-rae/Legends|Abregado-rae]]. On the day of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], tt was stationed at Gate 2A, and its status was on time, with an estimated time of arrival of 1455 hours. It was scheduled to depart again at 1550.
